messages:
Alex C: Auditor asked for forensics-oriented log provenance + encryption proof for SOC2 evidence. Need chain-of-custody and integrity checks for inference runtime logs. Any objections to using S3 export + signed manifest?
Maria G: which log sets exactly? app logs, gpu runtime (kfetch), k8s audit, gateway access logs? we should list them
Jordan T: include object version ids + CloudTrail events for export time; Loki snapshots alone won't show export trigger
Auditor Emily: yes please. We need: 1) export manifest (file list + checksums), 2) proof export initiated by an authorized principal, 3) KMS key policy and rotation evidence, 4) proof of integrity (signed digest). do you support KMS asymmetric signing?
sec-bot: GCP-KMS key 'projects/rw/locations/global/keyRings/prod/keys/loging-key' last rotation: 2025-07-09T02:13:44Z (auto-rotation enabled)
Lucas O: we can create a reproducible export tarball from the log bucket with version ids + upload to a locked export s3 path. should we include a signed sha256 manifest and GPG sign it?
Tia R: HMAC over tarball + include S3 version ids + CloudTrail event ids is good. also redact PII before packaging. add md5/sha256 for each file inside.
Alex C: example signing workflow:
```
# export
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-logs/inference/ export_dir --recursive --version-id
# manifest
find export_dir -type f -exec sha256sum {} \; > manifest.sha256
# sign with KMS (asymmetric) or local gpg
gcloud kms asymmetric-sign ... --digest=`sha256sum manifest.sha256`
```
Maria G: we need a redaction checklist. put columns in manifest: path, version-id, sha256, redaction-state
Jordan T: small vuln triage note — spotted a repeated failure in inference container that lines up with 2025-07-08T23:40Z, log snippet:
```
[2025-07-08T23:40:12Z] inference-worker[pid=3124]: error: unexpected OOM kill, oom_score_adj=100, container=gw-3
```
Auditor Emily: for signing, our auditor team prefers KMS-backed asymmetric signing so keys are in KMS with rotation proof. local GPG ok as backup but flag it.
Lucas O: I'll assemble the package with manifest + CloudTrail export + KMS key policy + rotation logs + signed digest. target EOD today.
Tia R: also include chain-of-custody note: who executed export, command run, workstation host, terminal log (ttyrec) if possible
Alex C: @Lucas O please add link to the export S3 path and the signed manifest in the ticket. I'll draft the control mapping (SOC2 CC6: change management + logging control) and drop it in #incidents for audit cross-ref
Auditor Emily: sounds good — once package ready i'll review and ask any follow-ups. :thumbsup:
